name: meeting-to-dashboard
description: Six skills that turn meeting notes and Slack threads into a self-updating project dashboard. Includes process-meeting, process-slack-thread, weekly-rollup, find-stalled-projects, init-dashboard, and add-item. Use whenever the user wants to capture meeting outcomes, log Slack discussions into a dashboard, generate a weekly project review, find dormant projects, or maintain a single-file project dashboard.
